property_summary: For any funded contract balance and any recipient address, when the owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) the reference contract forwards the entire contract balance to the provided recipient (leaving address(c).balance == 0); the mutant that first transfers the balance to owner can change final c.balance (non-zero) for some recipient addresses, so address(c).balance == 0 holds for the reference for all inputs but is violated by the mutant for some input.
change_summary: Insert an extra transfer sending the contract balance to owner before transferring to the provided recipient, altering final balances and observable behavior.
